name: Stock Pitch Builder

inputs.name: Your research so far — notes, model, or nothing yet
Format target: 2-minute verbal, 1-pager or full memo

steps.title: State consensus
steps.detail: What does the market believe? If you can’t articulate the other side, you don’t have a pitch yet.

steps.title: Articulate the variant view
steps.detail: "The market thinks X. I think Y because Z." Z must be evidence, not vibes.

steps.title: Quantify the skew
steps.detail: Target price if right, downside if wrong, rough probabilities. A pitch without asymmetry is a coin flip.

steps.title: Date the catalysts
steps.detail: What makes the market agree with you, and when? "It’s cheap" is not a catalyst.

steps.title: Define the kill criteria
steps.detail: What evidence would make you exit? Deciding this before pitching is what separates process from hope.

steps.title: Compress to format
steps.detail: The 2-minute version leads with the variant view and the skew. Cut everything that doesn’t support them.

steps.title: Delegate 1
steps.detail: Summarising consensus estimates and sell-side positioning

steps.title: Delegate 2
steps.detail: Compiling the evidence base with sources

steps.title: Delegate 3
steps.detail: Building the valuation scenarios from your assumptions

steps.title: Delegate 4
steps.detail: Drafting the structured pitch from your inputs

sections.name: Pitch architecture: thesis, variant view, valuation, catalysts, risks
sections.detail: Structure a long or short pitch the way buy-side interviewers and PMs actually evaluate them: what the market believes, what you believe differently and why, what it’s worth if you’re right, and what proves you wrong.

outputs.sourcePolicy: Every figure cites the page or filing it was read from; nothing is stated without a source.

verification.description: Consensus numbers are current, not stale
Evidence actually supports the variant claim — check each link in the chain
Valuation math foots; probabilities are yours, not invented
Variant view stated in one sentence
Risk/reward quantified with at least 2:1 skew or an explicit reason
Every catalyst has a date or window
Kill criteria are specific and observable

humanCheckpoints: The variant perception itself — this is the pitch
What kill criteria you’ll actually honour

display.jobToBeDone: Turn research into a pitch with a variant perception, not a book report.
